incidents.summary: Standard Life's head of life and pensions used a racist phrase during an office presentation and apologised, but remained in his role without disciplinary action.

sources.title: Standard Life
sources.quote: In January 2007, the head of Standard Life's life and pensions business, Trevor Matthews, used the racist phrase "nigger in the woodpile" while giving a presentation at one of the company's Edinburgh offices.

sources.title: Standard Life
sources.quote: After issuing an apology, Mr Matthews remained in his job and no disciplinary action was taken.

positives: Standard Life Aberdeen sold most of its Boohoo holdings following allegations of unsafe working conditions and illegally low pay in Boohoo's supply chain.
Standard Life Master Trust was onboarding 7,000 victims of pensions fraud.
Standard Life met its 2025 climate goals, including a 25% reduction in the emissions intensity of its listed equity and credit portfolio.
